note: Historic river park (a 1900s resort and riverboat stop) on the Cedar River eight miles north of Vinton; DNR-owned, run by Benton County Conservation. Ten electric and two non-electric sites on gravel turnouts in riverbank timber, open-air shelter, pit toilet, shoreline fishing, and a boat ramp usable only at high water. Hunting open around the campground Sept 15-May 15. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $16 electric ($10 non-electric), 12 sites, pit toilet, FCFS, mid-April to Oct 31 (all from Benton County's own pages). Note cleaned. Not waterfront stands. Phone typo found (472-4942 -> 472-4972).
flags: WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands (same measures as Hoefle-Dulin / Benton City-Fry). NAIP shows the campground as gravel turnouts under continuous canopy at ~42.2581,-92.0207 to -92.0190. The Cedar here is ~190 m wide (a wide sand bed at low water, riverfront scale), with its east bank treeline ~100-130 m west of the nearest turnout through unbroken forest; no open apron and no sightline. The oxbow NW (~42.260,-92.021) is behind the shelter area, not the sites. County photos show a river-shore view and a mowed clearing under trees, but no campsite with the river in view.

PIN: the stored pin 42.25903,-92.01711 is in timber ~250 m ENE of the camp turnouts (Google's park point is 42.25919,-92.02003). Suggested centroid 42.2582,-92.0199, borderline at the ~250 m threshold.
STATUS: the county page's current banner 'Campgrounds are closed and water is shut off to campgrounds.' is the ordinary end-of-season close (season ends Oct 31), not a status.

PHONE WRONG: stored 319-472-4942 looks like a typo. Benton County Conservation's own rules page gives the office as (319) 472-4972 ('call the Conservation office directly at (319) 472-4972'), and four other Benton entries store 472-4972. Benton City-Fry 3085 carries the same 4942 typo. Google 4.5 stars / 22 reviews. Electric amperage not posted.
